selection_metric: Equal-weight mean validation net return, unchanged

screen_gate.ranking: Only full may pass; it must independently beat matched_baseline and masked
screen_gate.scope: Selected/final gains >=2pp against EACH control; final stock/ETF gains >=0; drawdown worsening <=2pp. No future decline label selects weights.

constraints.features_actions_costs_reward: Only explicit3-field trailing price context differs. Shared eligible bar/ATR panels and first7 normalizer statistics; native full-state PPO, wide initialization, net-log reward, actions/costs/starts/discount/GAE unchanged.
constraints.short_side: Reconciled reporting on all symbols; ex-post negative-holding stock labels are reporting-only
constraints.success_claim: Development promotion is not independent confirmation or permission to trade
constraints.source: One frozen committed source for every smoke/screen/confirmation cell; export shares original ledger and allocation lock
constraints.normalization: Same immutable training-only normalizer and complete 26-symbol development panel for all arms

execution.preflight: 512-transition CPU Colab smoke for each of3 datasets; verify actual default Python and frozen contracts; same committed source for all arms
execution.cleanup: Retrieve and validate artifacts; verify owned teardown; retain selected/final weights and curves; publish checksums before removing duplicates

name: trend-context-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Explicit causal quarterly/annual price momentum and trailing closing-high drawdown may help direction decisions beyond the short-horizon baseline. Test information against both matched-warmup legacy and same-dimension zero controls; no predictive power assumed.

context.future_declining_labels: Reporting only, never input, weight, reward or checkpoint selection
context.normalization: Each training dataset only; identical first7 statistics across arms
context.comparison: All3 datasets have identical eligible bars/ATR, original validation execution dates unchanged; older short-warmup models are not matched controls
